diagnostics.message: The EBS CSI EKS add-on gets its service-account role ARN from the IRSA module, but that output only depends on the IAM role, not the policy attachment. The add-on may become active before the role has the permissions it needs; ensure the IRSA policy attachment completes first.

The VPC CNI EKS add-on uses the IRSA role ARN, while the role's IAM policy attachment is not included in that ARN's dependency chain. The add-on could be created before its required CNI permissions are attached.

The EventBridge target can be installed before the SQS queue policy grants EventBridge permission to send messages. This creates a window in which matching events may fail delivery; order target creation after the queue policy.
This explicit dependency is redundant: the target provider manifest is already an ancestor of the time-sleep resource, which the provider-config manifest depends on.
